_comment: Reviewed derivative substitutions, two-stage. 'candidate' is recorded only. 'upload-approved' authorizes transferring the reviewed bytes to the named QA database and provider, and nothing else. 'approved' authorizes replacing the original mapping, and only after a ready, protected artifact with matching evidence and a playable manifest. Never approve either stage on bytes FrameWorks has not processed, and never approve two asset ids for the same media.

plans.reason: CANDIDATE ONLY - not an approval. Tulleti - Brutality: AV1 10-bit original failed provider ingest; H.264 8-bit derivative decodes clean and matches its recorded evidence. Ledger identity confirmed (published Tulleti - Brutality); neither stage is approved. This is the published mapping and the record to prepare once the QA migration is applied.

_review.targets_note: supabaseOrigin must be the full https origin (no userinfo, port, path or query). providerEndpoint must be the complete https endpoint including path - a hostname alone would let the bearer token travel over http or to an unexpected port. providerTokenSha256 commits to the exact FRAMEWORKS_API_TOKEN approved: it proves that credential is the one in use, NOT which account owns it (one account may hold several tokens). Account identity needs providerAccountId from a provider identity query, which does not exist yet.
